meta.title: La Orquídea y el Oso | Specialty Organic Coffee from Tierradentro, Cauca — South Africa Mission 2026
meta.description: Specialty organic coffee grown by smallholder families in Inzá, Tierradentro (Cauca, Colombia). Export-ready product, traceability and the O&O Certified Origin Program for buyers in South Africa and West Africa.

hero.title: Coffee that regenerates the forest, ready for the African market
hero.subtitle: From the mountains of Inzá, Tierradentro, we export specialty organic coffee grown by smallholder families committed to protecting the forest. We are presenting our origin to buyers across South Africa and West Africa.

stats.foods: Diverse crops breaking the monoculture cycle

product.title: Specialty green coffee, traceable and export-ready
product.text: Our coffee is shade-grown across mountain microclimates between 1,700 and 2,100 masl, with careful post-harvest processing that highlights unique cup profiles. We are preparing the technical and commercial information your team needs to evaluate the product.

origin.title: Tierradentro: forest, culture and coffee in balance
origin.text: In Inzá, Cauca, coffee grows alongside native forest, agroforestry systems and a farming tradition passed down through generations. Every partner farm protects mountain ecosystems while producing coffee with a distinct identity, rooted in the ancestral territory of Tierradentro.
origin.bullet1: Partner smallholder families from Inzá, Tierradentro
origin.bullet3: Coffee-growing tradition with a regenerative focus

program.title: O&O Certified Origin Program
program.text: The O&O Index certifies the origin, traceability and social-environmental impact of every lot. It is our way of guaranteeing international buyers that behind every cup lies a verifiable, fair and regenerative process.

traceability.title: From forest to cup: traceability in progress
traceability.text: We are building a traceability module that will let every buyer look up the exact origin of their coffee: the farm, the producing family, the altitude, the post-harvest process and the conservation practices tied to that lot. This section will go live in a following phase of the project.
traceability.note: Space reserved for the lot-level traceability module.

contact.title: Let's talk about your next import
contact.text: Fill out the form and our commercial team will reach out to share samples, technical sheets and commercial terms adapted to your market.
